descripcion_geo: Roman province along the southern coast of the Black Sea (present-day northern Turkey). Homeland of Aquila the missionary.

historias.titulo: Aquila of Pontus: Jew expelled from Rome
historias.descripcion: Aquila, a native of Pontus, and his wife Priscilla are expelled from Rome by the edict of Claudius and settle in Corinth where they meet Paul.

historias.titulo: Peter writes to the believers of Pontus
historias.descripcion: Peter addresses his first letter to the 'elect' of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia.
The heretic Marcion of Pontus proposed rejecting the OT; Its controversy led the Church to define the canon.

personajes.descripcion: Jew from Pontus who with his wife Priscilla collaborated with Paul in Corinth and Ephesus.
Wife of Aquila; He instructed Apollos in the way of God more accurately.
He wrote his letter to the diaspora communities in Pontus.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Pontus: relevant region in the NT world.

cristianismo.descripcion: The missionary couple from Pontus, Aquila and Priscilla, represent the apostolic model of marriage in the service of the gospel.
